purpose: Make the first useful stock check easy to reach, set accurate plan expectations, and measure the path to a real customer.
approved_changes: Keep the existing H1 and all four requested actions; make Analyze a Stock primary.
Add an emotional supporting hook and show a dated public research example before ranking signup prompts.
Continue the selected stock through signup and explain free saving versus paid monitoring.
Use shared benefits-led plan descriptions and consistently mark options flow, API access and webhooks as future features.
Provide editable plain-text sharing drafts, a finding/caveat evidence table, sources and canonical article URLs with channel attribution.
Improve existing stock-analysis and insider-trading landing pages with a worked example and practical next steps.
Add acquisition reporting with ordered stock-before-signup checks and separate post-signup save, return, checkout and verified-payment outcomes.

keyword_evidence.limitation: Saved Keyword Planner ranges support category demand, not predicted Walnut traffic, organic difficulty or guaranteed conversions. No new keyword volume claim is made by this release.

measurement.location: Admin page analytics: Acquisition and new-account progress
measurement.primary: New non-internal accounts and verified positive live Stripe payments
diagnostics: Stock viewed before signup in a qualifying session
New accounts returning at least 24 hours later
measurement.interpretation: Compare sources over equivalent periods, report counts alongside rates, and avoid headline changes based on a handful of visits. A before/after comparison is observational, not a randomized experiment.
measurement.limitations: Consent, blockers and missing session identity leave accounts unattributed. Shared-account sessions are not stitched. Paid grants and test invoices are not purchases. Reports explicitly flag the 50,000-event cap. No production test purchase was made.

validation.backend: 14 focused tests passed: funnel analytics, account/payment reconciliation and acquisition cohorts.
validation.frontend: Focused homepage, privacy, attribution, signup, pricing, upgrades, sharing and commercial SEO checks passed.
validation.known_preexisting_test: admin-research-briefs public archive test expects getPublishedResearchBriefs directly in the route, while unchanged HEAD uses loadResearchArchive. The two admin-editor tests passed.
